name: FilmCraft
description: Create and edit video timelines, titles, captions, colour and audio headlessly; export finished sequences and frame previews.
progressive_guidance: The CLI downloads automatically from the pinned release archives. Operations run headlessly without opening a window or requiring a generation-provider account. Discover command IDs and params before editing. Ordinary edits stage a source copy and publish new files. Engine commands with explicit paths can still access the local filesystem; use file, script, preference or destructive operations only when explicitly requested. Preserve originals and inspect diagnostics. A successful command is not proof of visual quality: inspect a rendered preview before delivering artwork or video.

commands.description: Discover timeline, media, title, caption, colour and export engine commands.

filter.description: Text to search in the installed command registry.

inspect.description: Inspect the project tree and active timeline sequence without modifying the project.

edit.description: Create a timeline project or edit a source copy with an ordered command sequence; attach the new .fcproj file.

command.description: An engine command ID observed through commands.

params.description: Parameters discovered from the installed command registry.

inputPath.description: Absolute existing project/document. Omit to start a new empty project.

edit.progressive_guidance: Discover file.newSequence, import and timeline commands before constructing a sequence. Use absolute selected media paths. Inspect returned item/clip IDs instead of guessing. Projects reference external media: keep source assets available. Inspect the saved project and preview relevant timeline positions before export.

preview.description: Render a frame of the active sequence to PNG and attach bounded model evidence.

timeSeconds.description: Sequence position in seconds; defaults to zero.

render.description: Export the active sequence to completed MP4, GIF or WAV and attach the result.
render.progressive_guidance: Defaults to MP4 and the whole active sequence. Use startSeconds/endSeconds for an explicit range. Keep referenced media available. Use ffmpeg for ordinary file conversion and encoding tasks. Export presets stay in the Leon profile. A returned execution handle must settle before claiming completion.
